_doc: Models for run.py --matrix. json_mode: json_object for hosts without JSON-schema output (the schema then goes in the prompt). provider: ollama | openai (any OpenAI-compatible host, via base_url + key_env) | anthropic. price: $ per 1M [input, output] tokens, null when free or unknown (cost is then not logged). Entries whose key_env is unset are skipped. enabled: false entries run only with --select <id>. tested: the date a run of it worked; untested entries need their model id checked against the host's model list first.
